Build function that can be reproducibly used
```{r}
predict_jm_trajectory_hivinteraction <- function(
    jm,
    metabolite_idx,
    data.long,
    time_vec = c(0, 30),
    keep_iter = NULL,
    name_map = NULL) {
  library(dplyr)
  subjects <- as.character(jm$model_data$idT)
  n_chains <- length(jm$mcmc$b)
  if (is.null(keep_iter)) {
    keep_iter <- nrow(jm$mcmc$betas1[[1]])
  }
  iter_use <- seq_len(keep_iter)
  
  metname.model <- names(jm$model_data$extra_parms)
  
  if (!is.null(name_map)) {
    met_names <- unname(
      name_map[metname.model]
    )
  } else {
    met_names <- metname.model
  }
  met_name <- met_names[metabolite_idx]
  X_pred <- expand.grid(
    Subject_id = subjects,
    day = time_vec
  )
  X_pred$arm <- sapply(
    X_pred$Subject_id,
    function(s) {
      unique(
        data.long$arm[
          data.long$Subject_id == s
        ]
      )[1]
    }
  )
  X_pred$hiv_stt <- sapply(
    X_pred$Subject_id,
    function(s) {
      unique(
        data.long$hiv_stt[
          data.long$Subject_id == s
        ]
      )[1]
    }
  )
  X_pred$arm <- factor(
    X_pred$arm,
    levels = levels(data.long$arm))
  X_pred$hiv_stt <- factor(
    X_pred$hiv_stt,
    levels = levels(data.long$hiv_stt))
  
  Zmat <- model.matrix( ~ day, X_pred)
  Xmat <- model.matrix(~ day * arm + day * hiv_stt, X_pred)
  
  K <- 2
  RE_idx <- ((metabolite_idx - 1) * K + 1):(metabolite_idx * K)

  pred_draws <- simplify2array(
    lapply(iter_use, function(iter) {
      do.call(cbind, lapply(seq_len(n_chains), function(chain) {
          b_it <- jm$mcmc$b[[chain]][ , RE_idx, iter, drop = FALSE]
          # b_it <- matrix(b_it, ncol = K)
          b_it <- b_it[, , 1]
          rand_part <- rowSums( Zmat * b_it[match(X_pred$Subject_id,
                  subjects),
                ,drop = FALSE])
          beta_it <- jm$mcmc[[paste0("betas", metabolite_idx)]][[chain]][iter, ]
          fix_part <- as.vector(Xmat %*% beta_it)
          fix_part + rand_part
        })
      )
    })
  )
  # Convert: prediction × chain × iteration -> prediction × posterior_draw
  pred_mat <- matrix(
    aperm(pred_draws, c(1, 3, 2)),
    nrow = nrow(X_pred)
  )
  traj_df <- data.frame(
    Subject_id = X_pred$Subject_id,
    day = X_pred$day,
    arm = X_pred$arm,
    hiv_stt = X_pred$hiv_stt,
    median = apply(pred_mat,1,median),
    lwr = apply(pred_mat, 1, quantile,0.025),
    upr = apply(pred_mat, 1, quantile, 0.975)
  )
  obs_df <- data.long %>% dplyr::select(Subject_id, day, arm, hiv_stt, all_of(met_name))
  
  final_df <- traj_df %>% left_join(
      obs_df,by = c("Subject_id","day","arm", "hiv_stt")) %>% 
    dplyr::rename(pred = median, obs = all_of(met_name)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(value = if_else(!is.na(obs),obs,pred),
                  source = if_else(!is.na(obs),"observed","JM_imputed"), 
                  metabolite = met_name)
  # population-level trajectory
  pop_grid <- expand.grid(
    day = sort(unique(time_vec)),
    arm = levels(X_pred$arm),
    hiv_stt = levels(X_pred$hiv_stt))
  
  X_pop <- model.matrix(~ day * arm + day * hiv_stt, pop_grid)
  pop_draws <- simplify2array(
    lapply(iter_use, function(iter) {
      do.call(
        cbind,
        lapply(seq_len(n_chains), function(chain) {
          beta_it <- jm$mcmc[[paste0("betas", metabolite_idx)]][[chain]][iter, ]
          as.vector(X_pop %*% beta_it)
        })
      )
    })
  )
  pop_mat <- matrix(
    aperm(pop_draws, c(1, 3, 2)),
    nrow = nrow(X_pop)
  )
  pop_df <- data.frame(
    day   = pop_grid$day,
    arm = pop_grid$arm,
    hiv = pop_grid$hiv_stt,
    median  = apply(pop_mat, 1, median),
    lwr   = apply(pop_mat, 1, quantile, 0.025),
    upr   = apply(pop_mat, 1, quantile, 0.975),
    metabolite = met_name
    )
  return(
    list(
      traj_df = traj_df,
      final_df = final_df,
      pop_df = pop_df,
      pred_mat = pred_mat,
      pop_mat = pop_mat
    )
  )
}
summarise_posterior <- function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  data.frame(
    median = median(x),
    mean   = mean(x),
    sd     = sd(x),
    lwr    = quantile(x, 0.025),
    upr    = quantile(x, 0.975)
  )
}
pop_slope_mv_hivinteraction <- function(jm, metabolite_idx) {
  beta_mat <- beta_matrix(jm, metabolite_idx)
  beta_day <- beta_mat[, "day"]
  beta_hiv <- beta_mat[, "day:hiv_sttpositive"]
  
  list(
    hiv_negative       = beta_day,
    hiv_positive = beta_day + beta_hiv,
    delta_hiv          = beta_hiv
  )
}
pop_slope_mv_hivinteraction <- function(jm, metabolite_idx) {
  beta_mat <- beta_matrix(jm, metabolite_idx)
  beta_day <- beta_mat[, "day"]
  beta_hiv <- beta_mat[, "day:hiv_sttpositive"]
  
  list(
    hiv_negative       = beta_day,
    hiv_positive = beta_day + beta_hiv,
    delta_hiv          = beta_hiv
  )
}

Wald_P_hivinteraction <-
  function(jm, metabolite_idx, post_beta = "day:hiv_sttpositive") {
    sum_tbl <- summary_mvjm(jm, metabolite_idx)
    b  <- sum_tbl[post_beta, "Mean"]
    se <- sum_tbl[post_beta, "StDev"]
    z <- b / se
    p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z)))
    data.frame(z = z,
               p = p)
  }
wald_from_samples <- function(x) {

  est <- mean(x)
  se  <- sd(x)
  z <- est / se
  p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
  p <- pmax(p, 1e-300)
  data.frame(
    estimate = est,
    se = se,
    z = z,
    p = p
  )
}
build_beta_table_mv_hivinteraction <- function(jm,
                                met_names) {
  res_list <- lapply(seq_along(met_names),
                     function(i) {
                       met <- met_names[i]
                       beta_mat <- beta_matrix(jm, i)
                       post <- pop_slope_mv_hivinteraction(jm = jm, metabolite_idx = i)
                       hivnegative_sum <- summarise_posterior(post$hiv_negative)
                       hivpositive_sum <- summarise_posterior(post$hiv_positive)
                       delta_sum <- summarise_posterior(post$delta_hiv)
                       
                       beta_hivnegative <- beta_mat[, "day"]
                       wald_hivnegative <- wald_from_samples(beta_hivnegative)
                       beta_delta <- beta_mat[, "day:hiv_sttpositive"]
                       wald_delta <- wald_from_samples(beta_delta)
                       beta_hivpositive <- beta_mat[, "day"] + beta_mat[, "day:hiv_sttpositive"]
                       wald_hivpositive <- wald_from_samples(beta_hivpositive)
                       
                       delta_df <- data.frame(
                         metabolite = met,
                         contrast   = "Delta",
                         median     = delta_sum$median,
                         mean       = delta_sum$mean,
                         sd         = delta_sum$sd,
                         lwr        = delta_sum$lwr,
                         upr        = delta_sum$upr,
                         p          = wald_delta$p
                       )
                       negative_df <- data.frame(
                         metabolite = met,
                         contrast   = "Negative",
                         median     = hivnegative_sum$median,
                         mean       = hivnegative_sum$mean,
                         sd         = hivnegative_sum$sd,
                         lwr        = hivnegative_sum$lwr,
                         upr        = hivnegative_sum$upr,
                         p          = wald_hivnegative$p
                       )
                       positive_df <- data.frame(
                         metabolite = met,
                         contrast   = "Positive",
                         median     = hivpositive_sum$median,
                         mean       = hivpositive_sum$mean,
                         sd         = hivpositive_sum$sd,
                         lwr        = hivpositive_sum$lwr,
                         upr        = hivpositive_sum$upr,
                         p          = wald_hivpositive$p
                       )
                       rbind(negative_df,
                             positive_df,
                             delta_df)
                     })
  beta_table <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
  rownames(beta_table) <- NULL
  return(beta_table)
}
plot_met_trajectory_hiv <- function(
    met_name,
    all_final_df,
    all_pop_df,
    ref_labels = NULL,
    delta_labels = NULL,
    name_map = NULL
) {

  display_name <- if (!is.null(name_map)) {
    unname(name_map[met_name])
  } else {
    met_name
  }
  plot_dat <- all_final_hiv_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(metabolite == met_name)
  pop_dat <- all_pop_hiv_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(metabolite == met_name)
  
      # HIV-negative slope text
    ref_beta_text <- NULL
    
    if (!is.null(ref_labels)) {
    
      stat_row <- ref_labels %>%
        dplyr::filter(metabolite == met_name)
    
      ref_beta_text <- paste0(
        "\u03B2[HIV-] = ",
        sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$median),
        " [",
        sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$lwr),
        ", ",
        sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$upr),
        "]",
        "; FDR = ",
        ifelse(stat_row$fdr < 0.001,
               "<0.001",
               sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$fdr))
      )
    }

    # HIV interaction effect
    delta_beta_text <- NULL
    
    if (!is.null(delta_labels)) {
    
      stat_row <- delta_labels %>%
        dplyr::filter(metabolite == met_name)
    
      delta_beta_text <- paste0(
        "\u0394\u03B2[HIV] = ",
        sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$median),
        " [",
        sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$lwr),
        ", ",
        sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$upr),
        "]",
        "; FDR = ",
        ifelse(stat_row$fdr < 0.001,
               "<0.001",
               sprintf("%.3f", stat_row$fdr))
      )
    }
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_line( data = plot_dat, aes(x = day, y = value, group = interaction(Subject_id, hiv_stt), colour = hiv_stt), alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 0.2) +
    
    geom_ribbon(data = pop_dat, aes(x = day, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr, fill = hiv), alpha = 0.3, colour = NA ) +
    
    geom_line(data = pop_dat, aes(x = day, y = median, colour = hiv, linetype = arm), linewidth = 0.8) + 
    annotate("text",x = 1, y = 4.8, label = ref_beta_text,hjust = 0,vjust = 1,size = 3.2,color = "black") +
    annotate("text",x = 1, y = 4, label = delta_beta_text, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.2, color = "black") +
    
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 30)) + 
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-4, 5)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Negative" = "#1f77b4", "Positive" = "#d62728")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Negative" = "#1f77b4", "Positive" = "#d62728")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c( "Placebo" = "solid", "Dexamethasone" = "dotdash")) + 
    
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "Study day",
      y = display_name,
      colour = "HIV status",
      fill = "HIV status",
      linetype = "Treatment"
    ) + 
    guides(fill = "none", colour = guide_legend(order = 1), linetype = guide_legend(order = 2)) + 
    theme(
      axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 10, face = "plain", color = "black"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 10, face = "plain", color = "black"),
      strip.text    = element_text(size = 10, face = "plain"),
      legend.position="bottom",
      # legend.position = "inside", 
      # legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.2),
      legend.background = element_rect( fill = alpha("white", 0.7), colour = "grey90"),
      legend.text = element_text(colour="black", size=10, face="bold"),
      legend.key = element_blank())
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
  p <- plot_list[[i]]
```

We report the detailed beta along with the visualisation
```{r}
met_names <- names(results_multi_hiv$model_data$extra_parms)
beta_table_mv_hivinteraction <- build_beta_table_mv_hivinteraction (
  jm = results_multi_hiv,
  met_names = met_names)
beta_table_mv_hivinteraction$metabolite <- name_map_tbl[beta_table_mv_hivinteraction$metabolite]
beta_table_mv_hivinteraction$fdr <- p.adjust(
  beta_table_mv_hivinteraction$p,
  method = "BH"
)

beta_table_mv_hivinteraction$contrast <- factor(
  beta_table_mv_hivinteraction$contrast,
  levels = c(
    "Negative",
    "Positive",
    "Delta"
  )
)
beta_table_mv_hivinteraction$metabolite <- factor(
  beta_table_mv_hivinteraction$metabolite,
  levels = met_order
)
beta_all_fmt <- beta_table_mv_hivinteraction %>%
  mutate(
    est_cri = sprintf(
      "%.3f [%.3f, %.3f]",
      median,
      lwr,
      upr
    ),
    p = ifelse(
      is.na(p),
      "",
      formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 2)
    ),
    fdr = ifelse(
      is.na(fdr),
      "",
      formatC(fdr, format = "e", digits = 2)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    metabolite,
    contrast
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    metabolite,
    contrast,
    est_cri,
    p,
    fdr
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Metabolite = metabolite,
    Contrast = contrast,
    `β [95% CrI]` = est_cri,
    `Wald-p` = p,
    `BH-FDR` = fdr
  )
ft <- flextable(beta_all_fmt)
ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)
ft <- autofit(ft)
ft <- merge_v(ft,j = "Metabolite")
ft <- valign(ft,valign = "top",part = "body")
ft <- bold(ft,part = "header")
ft <- align(ft,align = "center",part = "all")
doc <- read_docx()
doc <- body_add_par(doc,
  "Population-level longitudinal slopes from multivariate joint models",
  style = "heading 1")
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc,value = ft)
print(doc,target = "./tables/MJM_trajectory_HIVinteraction.docx")
```
